fusions.name: Unhurried Nudge
fusions.desc: Sends a slow wash into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolling Swell
fusions.desc: Rolls a swell outward from you, which deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and pushes each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Time to Graze
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 3 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of water fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4s for 8s.

fusions.name: Even Keel
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
